heading: Public Works Backs GPS Equipment Replacement
summary: Engineering staff asked to use the aerial imagery fund to replace GPS equipment. Staff said inspectors use the equipment for surveying, staking and checking elevations. The committee voted in favor of the budget amendment.

heading: Wisconsin Secures $48 Million Judgment in Used Auto Parts Case
summary: State agencies announced a $48 million consumer protection judgment involving Midwest Auto Recycling and related businesses. Engine and Transmission World was among the companies named. The case concerned misrepresentations about used parts sold to consumers.
